description.value: Wendy's is a national fast food chain known for its square-pattied fresh beef burgers, chicken sandwiches, and signature Frosty® desserts. This Burnaby location on Kingsway offers a broad menu spanning breakfast through late night, including salads, chili, and hot coffee alongside the classic burger lineup. The drive-through and indoor dining room make it a reliable, weather-independent stop for cyclists passing through the Kingsway corridor.
